rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. Carryovers are refused before this worksheet is used: `sd.count` refuses on `sd.other_forms` ("Are there gains/losses from Forms 4797, 2439, 6252, 4684, 6781, 8824 or Schedule K-1?") and on `sd.carryover` ("Is there a capital loss carryover from the prior year?"), and that refusal reaches Form 1040 line 7a through Schedule D lines 7, 15 and 16, so no return with those items is prepared.
